title: Starblade
description: a powerful sword with a leap ability (15 sec cooldown)
body:
This mod adds a sword that is more powerful than Netherite, with a custom crafting recipe and a
  leap ability (left-click).

The sword is intended to make travelling on-foot faster and less tedious, and also make player-
  vs-player or player-vs-entity encounters more varied and exciting.

This mod was created using MCreator 2024.4.

Be aware that a Forge client for Minecraft 1.20.1 is needed:
  https://files.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/index_1.20.1.html
